verdict.rationale: The annual-report page states the covered filing type and geography: Harbor files annual reports automatically in all states through direct integration with secretary of state databases and portals. No pricing for the annual-report filing service appears in the evidence; the only published price ($99/year) is for the registered agent service, a different offering. missing for 10: published pre-purchase pricing for annual report filings (service fees vs. state fees), a per-state or per-filing-type coverage list, independent corroboration.
